versions.content: Behavior if one client starting a new operation while the pre- vious one is still running In case any of the Dem_SelectDTC related APIs ac- cording to [SWS_Dem_01253] is called by one client and the same client has already started another Dem_SelectDTC related operation according to [SWS_Dem_01253] and this different operation is not completed, the Dem shall return DEM_BUSY.
